title: Markdown Notes
summary: Notes as plain Markdown files in a folder: write, preview, open by name.
description: Notes are .md files in one folder (~/Notes by default), readable by any Markdown editor and easy to sync with Syncthing, rsync or git (the app does not sync itself). The preview shows headings, lists, code, task boxes you can tick and [[links]] between notes; new notes open in an editor that saves by itself. No network. Best with a Bluetooth or USB keyboard; the on-screen keyboard appears while none is connected.
